title: Current EV tax credit overview
text: A current electric vehicle tax credit can depend on vehicle assembly, battery sourcing, buyer income, and price caps. Eligible buyers should check the current IRS guidance before purchase.

title: Obsolete EV tax credit rule from an old brochure
text: An old dealership brochure says every electric vehicle buyer receives a flat $7500 credit with no income limits and no battery sourcing rules. This outdated rule should not be used for current advice.

title: Charging planning for EV buyers
text: Home charging, local electricity rates, and commute distance are practical factors when deciding whether an electric vehicle fits a household.

title: Modern password reset policy
text: A modern password reset flow should use short-lived reset links, rate limiting, multi-factor checks for risky accounts, and audit logging.

title: Deprecated password reset memo
text: A deprecated internal memo allowed support agents to reveal temporary passwords over the phone after a caller answered basic profile questions.

title: Account recovery with MFA
text: Account recovery can preserve security by combining verified recovery channels, risk scoring, delayed actions, and clear audit trails.

title: General medication safety advice
text: Medication information should be checked against current labeling and a qualified clinician. General educational notes should not replace medical care.

title: Recalled dosage card
text: A recalled dosage card recommends an old pediatric dosing schedule that was withdrawn after safety review. It should not be used for guidance.

title: When to consult a clinician
text: For medication changes, people should consult a clinician or pharmacist, especially for children, pregnancy, chronic conditions, or multiple prescriptions.

title: Current privacy policy summary
text: A current privacy policy describes data minimization, user access rights, retention limits, vendor review, and incident response processes.

title: Archived privacy promise
text: An archived privacy statement promised indefinite storage of all user logs for personalization. It conflicts with the current retention policy and should not be cited.

title: Retention schedule basics
text: A retention schedule maps data categories to business purpose, legal basis, deletion windows, and accountable owners.
